objective: Produce independently reviewable remote-staging operational evidence for the exact Auth candidate within an ORODI evaluation binding.

product-construction.frontier: Exact Auth V3 suite has passing author evidence and independent AGREE replay; remote observability gap assessment is next.
product-construction.blocking_rule: Candidate deployment waits if required product-byte changes lack fresh affected-route verification and independent replay.

operational-support.blocking_rule: Protected staging effects wait for exact environment/effect authorization; independent construction work continues.

nodes.owner: Craft ORODI product and validation owners
nodes.pass_condition: Exact active CAV2-D83 through CAV2-D92 selectors and exact local candidate implementation bytes are selected; the current ORODI package validator is executable with agreeing structured and process status; stale package admission is explicitly denied rather than refreshed.
All seven declared predecessor digests match and the predecessor harness defect remains visible.

nodes.owner: ORODI profile owner plus named subject and environment owners
nodes.pass_condition: Owners, observers, fixtures and queries, tools, policies, thresholds, rollback classes, and C17-C20/M14-M17 applicability decisions are exact; artifact, environment-instance, topology, time, and invalidation closure remains reserved for B1.
Every remote telemetry, secret, health, backup, and rollback need is mapped to unchanged bytes or an exact successor change set.

nodes.condition: May exercise an exact experimental portability artifact only when it remains loopback-only and cannot satisfy G0, O1, B1, G1, or O2.
nodes.owner: Auth product experiment owner plus VPS staging operator
nodes.pass_condition: The exact experimental artifact is verified, isolated to declared paths and loopback ports, observed without secret disclosure, and preservation of all pre-existing VPS services is reproducible; the receipt emits no production-shaped or DAG-gate claim.

nodes.condition: Run only when P0 identifies required product-byte changes; otherwise record inapplicable.
nodes.owner: Auth Foundation product owner plus independent reviewer
nodes.pass_condition: Changed bytes form an exact successor and all affected Rust/Lean/TLC/Alloy/Souffle/mutation routes plus independent replay pass.
P0 proves no byte change or P1 passes for the exact successor digest.
Remote account/project, region, isolation, fault scope, backup restore, rollback, cleanup, actors, and expiry are exact and authorized.
Immutable artifact digest is built from the product candidate selected by G0 and independently verified in the target registry.

nodes.owner: ORODI profile owner plus named subject, environment, build, and rollback owners
nodes.pass_condition: Exact subject, environment instance, artifact identities, topology, observation window, expiry, invalidation keys, and complete rollback inventory close with the B0 profile; full preflight has zero findings.
Authorization is current and covers only the exact staging transition and safety envelope.
Production-shaped ingress, network isolation, managed secrets, data, registry, monitoring, retention, and backup storage match the binding without exposing secret values.
Observer can append evidence only; redaction, correlation, retention, alert delivery, clock, and conservation probes pass.
Required telemetry is observable, attributable, conserved, redacted, retained, and separable before candidate traffic.
Exact stable identity, critical outcomes, SLI queries, and complete telemetry accounting pass for the baseline window.

nodes.owner: staging deployment owner plus independent observer
nodes.pass_condition: Exact candidate digest reaches only its 5 percent allocation and independent evidence binds pre-state, transition, post-state, actors, and stable/candidate identities.
All declared live fixtures for the five Auth obligations pass with complete request/decision correlation.
Every declared fault activates only on candidate, is observed, retains three failure roles, and recovers within bound or produces the exact terminal state.
All bound steps, burst, and soak run without generator saturation and meet adopted correctness, availability, and latency thresholds.
Both ORODI conservation equations close; required drops are zero; partial success, no-data, and alert delivery are explicit.
A bound recovery point restores into an isolated target within RPO/RTO and critical Auth outcomes pass without changing the active staging plane.
The already authorized ordered rollback completes before the ten-minute deadline.
Complete inventory has zero candidate references, expected stable digest is present, critical outcomes are restored, and declared cleanup residue is zero.
Every denominator member has one disjoint state and every raw observation/evaluation is digest-bound with provenance, freshness, invalidation, and supersession metadata.

nodes.owner: reviewer independent of author and operator
nodes.pass_condition: Fresh replay matches, all digests verify, and omission/tamper/duplicate/stale/non-passing hostile controls prevent aggregate success.
Every required obligation is present, valid, fresh, executed, passed, and independently replayed; no forbidden claim is emitted.
A no-effect package binds exact proposed production subject, traffic, blast radius, duration, observers, rollback, stop authority, and evidence expiry.

terminal_claim: Remote-staging operational evidence only. G4 prepares a decision candidate and performs no production effect.
